item.title: Golf, soccer, boxing: Is Saudi Arabia pulling back from sport?, a scenario moved
item.comments: LIV Golf lays off most of its staff and no longer rules out bankruptcy, the tight schedule doesn't hold +22 points (42%) — the "clean" exit praised in V1 falls back to 25% (-20 points).
item.description:
LIV Golf lays off most of its staff and no longer rules out bankruptcy, the tight schedule doesn't hold +22 points (42%) — this scenario climbs from 20% to 42%, while the "clean" exit falls from 45% to 25% and the persisting uncertainty edges down slightly from 35% to 33%.

Despite the investor deal announced on August 5, LIV Golf has been going through a severe financial rough patch since mid-August: its season-ending event's purse cut in half, players unpaid at Bedminster, mass layoffs, and four lawsuits from unpaid vendors filed between August 18 and 28. CEO Scott O'Neil no longer rules out the possibility of bankruptcy.

See the full update, scenario by scenario 👉 lesscenarios.fr/suivi/arabie-saoudite-sport.html
